programs.name: Community Alternatives Program for Disabled Adults (CAP/DA) waiver

programs.name: State/County Special Assistance In-Home (SAIH)

programs.keyRule: 2026 SAIH: TCMI must be below $1,861.51 (Enhanced, dementia on FL-2) or $1,466.51 (Basic); resource limit $2,000; must need adult care home level of care (FL-2) and pass a safety assessment

programs.name: Medicare Savings Program - QMB (MQB-Q)
programs.agency: NC Medicaid (NCDHHS Division of Health Benefits), applied for at Mecklenburg County DSS or ePASS
programs.reason: Income $1,050 is under the 100% FPL limit and savings $1,200 under $9,950; as a full Medicaid member she should already be dual-eligible with Part B paid.

programs.name: Extra Help (Medicare Part D Low-Income Subsidy)

programs.name: Food and Nutrition Services (FNS / SNAP)

FY2027 SNAP figures (Oct 2026) were inferred from the 2026 poverty guidelines.

programs.name: VA Veterans Pension with Aid and Attendance
programs.agency: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (help free from a county Veterans Service Officer)
programs.reason: He served in the Vietnam era (wartime begins 8/5/1964 for service outside Vietnam), is 65+, and needs help bathing and supervision for dementia. After subtracting both Medicare Part B premiums ($4,870/yr) above the $1,141 deductible, countable income is about $33,471, under the $34,488 A&A rate with a spouse. That pays about $85/month now and much more if they pay for in-home care. Net worth ($38,000 plus income) is far below $163,699.
programs.keyRule: MAPR with one dependent spouse, A&A: $34,488/yr (12/1/2025); medical expenses over 5% of basic MAPR ($1,141) are deducted; net worth limit $163,699; 90 days active duty with 1 day wartime

firstCall.phoneOrWhere: Mecklenburg County Veterans Service Officer (free) or VA 1-800-827-1000; forms 21P-534EZ and 21-2680
firstCall.why: She qualifies on today's facts, and if she pays her daughter for care under a written agreement, that cost can be deducted and the payment rises toward $1,558/month. SLMB (through DSS or ePASS) is the next quick win.

families.notes: The biggest long-term lever is spending savings down to $2,000 (excluded burial contract, home modifications): that unlocks SAIH Basic plus automatic Medicaid, then PCS and CAP/DA (CAP/DA consumer direction can pay an adult child). VA pension income interacts with SAIH/Medicaid: the base pension counts but A&A/medical-expense portions are generally excluded under SSI rules; a counselor should sequence these. Assumes the daughter owns the home and they share meals.
